# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and memory refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves Android presentation, stream lifetime handling, and managed image and text processing. This release also includes the WebGPU implementation in the native library, reducing integration work for consumers using that backend.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for more reliable frame presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain unnecessary data** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention so data can be released when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Image copies and text shaping reduce allocation overhead** — Optimizes managed image pixel copies, feature-string handling, and HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding buffers to reduce work and transient allocations. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU implementation ships in the native library** — Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp into libSkiaSharp.a for consumers using the WebGPU backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
